Mein qasam khata hon us shehar ki.
Jabke (ae payghumbar) tum us shehar mein muqeem ho
Aur (qasam khata hon) baap ki aur us ki aulad ki.
Ke hum ne insan ko mushakkat mein paida kiya hai.
Kya woh yeh samajhta hai ke us par kisi ka bas nahin chale ga ?
Kehta hai ke : mein ne dhairon maal ura dala hai.
Kya woh yeh samajhta hai ke us ko kisi ne dekha nahin ?
Kya hum ne use do aankhein nahin den ?
Aur ek zubaan aur do honth nahin diye ?
Aur hum ne us ko dono raaste bata diye hain.
Phir woh us ghati mein dakhil nahin hoska.
Aur tumhein kya pata ke woh ghati kya hai ?
Kisi ki gardan (gulami se) chhra dena hai.
Ya phir kisi bhook wale din mein khana khla dena
Kisi rishta daar yateem ko.
Ya kisi miskeen ko jo mitti mein rala raha ho.
Phir woh un logon mein bhi shamil hua jo iman laye hain, aur jinhon ne ek dusre ko saabit qadami ki takeed ki hai, aur ek dusre ko reham khane ki takeed ki hai.
Yehi woh log hain jo bare naseeb wale hain.
Aur jin logon ne hamari aayaton ka inkar kiya hai, woh nahoosat wale log hain.
Un par aisi aag musallat hogi jo un par bandh kardi jaye gi.
